environments.name: International Space Station (ISS)
environments.suggestedRoutineFocus: Microgravity fluid shift management, daily 2.5h ARED/T2 resistance, real-time Flight Surgeon tele-clinic
environments.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 & 2; ISS Medical Operations Requirements Document (MORD)

environments.name: Deep-Space Transit Vehicle (DSTV)
environments.radiationLevel: Critical (Galactic Cosmic Rays + Solar Particle Event risks, ~1.5 mSv/day)
environments.suggestedRoutineFocus: Autonomous medical stabilization, radiation shelter readiness, sleep debt mitigation, asynchronous clinical logging
environments.source: NASA Mars Design Reference Architecture 5.0 (NASA-SP-2009-566); NASA HRP ExMC Gap Analysis

environments.name: Artemis Lunar Base Camp
environments.radiationLevel: High (Lunar surface secondary neutrons + unshielded cosmic rays, ~1.0 mSv/day)
availableInstruments: Lunar Dust & Regolith Air Toxicity Sensor
environments.suggestedRoutineFocus: Toxic abrasive regolith dust decontamination, partial-G locomotion transition, 14-day lunar night circadian maintenance
environments.source: NASA Artemis Human Landing System Crew Health Specifications; NASA-STD-3001

environments.name: Mars Surface Habitat & Rover
environments.suggestedRoutineFocus: Autonomous crew health management, 24.6h Martian Sol circadian alignment, EVA physical recovery
environments.source: NASA Human Research Roadmap: Risk of Inability to Adequately Treat an Ill or Injured Crew Member
